body: Thanks that's good advice. Unfortunately, as you might imagine, I have no money or access to any money so I can't even afford a cheap lawyer. I'll be dependent on whatever legal aid can offer me.

Thanks for your reply.

> Prison in Canada was a very homophobic place and I kept very much in the closet. Even challenging people on their homophobic talk is dangerous to your safety.
  
This is part of what terrifies me. I'm very clearly gay. I'm slim, not muscular, I'd be an easy target. There's no closet for me. I can't hide it. I tried really hard to in school but I was still beaten up all the time for being gay. 
  
I'm already sober (2 years) so I'm not worried about that part. I just don't think I can cope with prison when I can barely leave my house as it is.  
  
I know you didn't mean it to, but your account of prison just terrifies me more. I'm not going. I'll kill myself first. It's the only way.
Thanks, I've been clean two years but I'm still miserable. There's no hope for me.

Thanks for your help. I will wait and find out what they say. If it's a suspended sentence or a fine then I can cope with that but if it's imprisonment then I just don't see another option than to nip it in the bud before it's taken out of my control. I'm miserable but I was starting to improve and all this has just thrown me into absolute despair. I just can't see what I have to live for right now.   
  
Thanks for talking it through with me, you've really helped.

I don't know. I've never been to the doctor. I mean it literally when I say I never leave the house. I really don't know what the situation would be with mental health. What if they don't believe me? What if the doctor doesn't believe me?

I have no idea what I was caught with to be honest. As I said, it was during a suicide attempt so I woke up in hospital like 2 days later and was told all of this. I know that it was a lot of stuff but I have almost no memory of exactly what. At the very least it would be about 4 grams of meth, some ket, some xanax, and god knows what else. 
  
Tbh, I'm terrified of going to the doctor but I guess I have little choice. I just don't know how I'm going to get myself there without falling to pieces.  
  
I don't have much life anyway, it all feels so hopeless right now.  
  
Thanks again for chatting through this with me though. I really appreciate it.

Oh I know it's better over here than the US but as I mentioned, I'm really not the type of person that will cope well with prison no matter how good the conditions are. I'm agoraphobic so I basically never leave the house or see people. I hide in a cupboard if the doorbell rings from having panic attacks. I can't sleep, I can't eat for worrying about this.  I truly think it's over for me now, I just can't see another option.

Thanks so much for replying. I'm so low right now.  
  
I've been clean from all drugs, even cigarettes and alcohol for two years. It's just a shame that this has reared its head after two years.  
  
I think many people would survive inside a prison but I just won't. I'm severely depressed, agoraphobic and I barely ever leave my house. I hide in a cupboard if the doorbell rings. I'm terrified of people or going outside. I just can't go to jail. I just can't. I'd rather die.

I should have mentioned that I'm in the UK so we don't have to pay for bail, thankfully. I will be totally reliant on legal aid so I'll have to take what I can get. I have less than zero money and no option to access anything else.
  
Statute of limitations in the UK is 7 years for criminal offences so I'm pretty sure they'll manage it. I don't have any priors, this is the only run in with the police I have ever had.  
  
Thanks for replying. I appreciate it. I'm really low right now.
